overrides.name: Brughor Axe-Biter
overrides.subjectPrompt: An orc raider captain of the Many Arrows, heavyset gray-sage skin, broad nose and pronounced lower tusks, battered dark hide armor with a weathered muted ocher fur shoulder guard, one rough engraved iron greataxe held low across the figure. Cold wind-tangled swept-back coarse dark hair and a strip of dusty burgundy cloth at the belt. Both boots and the complete axe inside square. Original appearance for the named character.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment

overrides.name: King Grol
overrides.subjectPrompt: A fierce old bugbear ruler of the Cragmaws, taller and broad with a stooped neck and hunched heavy shoulders, rust-brown coarse fur grayed around the long muzzle, swept pointed ears, amber watchful eyes. Heavy patchwork hide armor over muted dark russet fur and a dull bronze clasp, holding an iron morningstar upside down so it rests near one boot. Intimidating stance and aged features. Original appearance, no wolf or other figures.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment

overrides.name: Lhupo
overrides.subjectPrompt: A small shrewd moss-gray goblin wearing a dirty faded charcoal robe over scraps of leather armor, long angular ears, sharp amber eyes, narrow bony face. One hand carries an old brass censer suspended from a short chain, the other gathers the frayed sleeve. A small thread of incense smoke close to the figure. No supernatural light. Original interpretation of the shrine keeper, no companions.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment

overrides.name: Targor Bloodsword
overrides.subjectPrompt: An ambitious Cragmaw hobgoblin warband leader with reddish brown skin, narrow disciplined dark eyes, angular pointed ears and dark hair in a tight knot. Blackened iron lamellar armor with quiet wine-colored cloth edging and a practical leather sash. Holds a plain longsword obliquely, tip down and fully in frame, one mailed glove resting at the belt. Use a clean steel blade with dull warm reflection. Original appearance, no blood and no fighting.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment

overrides.name: Yeemik
overrides.subjectPrompt: A wiry, shrewd olive-green goblin second-in-command with jutting asymmetrical ears, alert golden eyes and sly set jaw. Layered rusty umber leather armor and a dark slate blue neck wrap, with a little straight sword tucked in a scabbard. Standing at three quarters, one loose hand raised in a parley gesture, the other on the belt. Original appearance. No hostage or cave.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment

overrides.name: Yegg
overrides.subjectPrompt: A portly, grumpy Cragmaw goblin chief cook with olive green skin, wide flattened nose and angular ears, one brow lowered. Faded brick red rolled sleeves underneath a flour-dusted beige leather apron, worn knee-length trousers and bare goblin feet. Holds a long wooden spoon down at one side and a shallow iron cooking pot tucked against his hip. Original appearance, no kitchen or gore.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment
